item.title: Bulletin updated at 05:50 HKT 04/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will persist over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. There will be a few showers over the region. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will be generally fine over southern China early to midweek next week.

Date/Month: 04/11 (Friday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers.
Temp range: 22 - 24 C
R.H. range: 85 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
